usedFor: CalendarHero collects meeting requests and Sangam CRM keeps the leads behind them through “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “Meeting Request Becomes Event” in CalendarHero, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A confirmed meeting is a warm lead, and an existing lead is updated rather than doubled.

watchOut: “Create or Update Lead” matches on ID, email or phone, so pass at least one of them.
